chapters.title: Numerical Optimization: Reading Guide
chapters.description: Connect update geometry, curvature, games, adaptive step lengths, and communication-efficient matrix optimizers.

chapters.title: Optimizer Geometry: From Gradient Descent to AdamW
chapters.description: Understand curvature through a quadratic, derive momentum and Adam updates, and separate adaptive scaling from decoupled weight decay.

chapters.title: Newton and Gauss–Newton: Use Curvature Without Forming an Inverse
chapters.description: Derive Newton and damped Gauss–Newton from local models, solve a numerical least-squares example, and understand singular curvature and acceptance tests.

chapters.title: GAN Optimization: Rotations, Fixed Points, and a Rank-One Preconditioner
chapters.description: See why descent–ascent can rotate, derive the rank-one update in the Gauss–Newton GAN paper, and inspect the limits of its local model.

chapters.title: Angle-Based Step Lengths: Probe the Gradient Field
chapters.description: Explain the perpendicular probe in angle-based gradient descent, derive its spherical example, and handle small angles and stochastic-gradient noise.

chapters.title: Muon: Why the Shape of a Weight Matrix Matters
chapters.description: Derive the polar update from a spectral-norm constraint, distinguish it from elementwise sign, and understand practical orthogonalization and parameter groups.

chapters.title: SignMuon: Matrix Directions, Majority Votes, and the Actual Bytes Sent
chapters.description: Trace the paper’s distributed algorithm, distinguish sign aggregation from averaging, and calculate communication without confusing one-bit information with an integer collective.
